newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ESNAIDER STRIKE PUTS ATLETICO FOURTH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ESNAIDER STRIKE PUTS ATLETICO FOURTH.

text.p: Spanish champions Atletico Madrid continued their recovery after a poor start to the season with a 1-0 home victory over Racing Santander on Saturday.
Juan Eduardo Esnaider's strike left Atletico on 27 points from 15 games, five behind leaders Real Madrid whose match at Sporting Gijon kicked off later on Saturday.

Atletico's improvement -- they have clocked up five wins and a draw in their last six matches -- has coincided with the return from injury of international midfielder Jose Luis Caminero. He was again prominent against Racing.
